title: Copernicus DEM GLO-30, release 2024_1
description: The Copernicus DEM GLO-30 digital surface model, release 2024_1, as 26,475 items, one per 1° × 1° tile, at 1 arcsecond in latitude (about 30 m) with longitude spacing that widens towards the poles. Heights are in metres above the EGM2008 geoid (EPSG:3855) on WGS84 (EPSG:4326), RasterPixelIsPoint. Each item has five cloud-optimized GeoTIFFs: the elevation model and the height error, editing, filling and water body masks, plus the product XML. Every raster was re-encoded losslessly and checked pixel for pixel against its source. Tiles are trimmed by the last row and column they share with their south and east neighbours, matching the AWS Open Data copy. There are no tiles over open ocean. Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for access patterns.

dem.title: Elevation (DSM)
dem.description: Digital surface model heights in metres above the EGM2008 geoid (EPSG:3855), float32, RasterPixelIsPoint. The handbook gives -32,767 as a NoData value for "EEA-10 only"; GLO-30 is void-filled and this asset declares no nodata.

hem.title: Height Error Mask (HEM)
hem.description: "The Height Error Mask (HEM) represents the corresponding height error for each DEM pixel in the form of the standard deviation derived from the interferometric coherence and geometrical considerations." Edited pixels are coded -32,767 (declared as nodata): "The Editing Mask as well as the Filling Mask support the interpretation of the HEM for areas coded with -32,767."

edm.title: Editing Mask (EDM)
edm.description: Editing applied to each DEM pixel (handbook Table 6). 0 is "Void (no data)".

classification:classes.name: morphed
classification:classes.title: Morphed pixels (series of pixels manually set)

flm.title: Filling Mask (FLM)
flm.description: "All edited and filled pixels are flagged in this mask. For filled pixels, the fill source is specified." (handbook 1.2.5.2, Table 7). 0 is "Void (no data)".

wbm.title: Water Body Mask (WBM)
wbm.description: "The Water Body Mask (WBM) shows all DEM pixels, which are classified as water and edited according to the categories Ocean, Lake or River." (handbook 1.2.5.4, Table 8). 0 means "No water" and is a value, not nodata.

metadata.title: Product metadata (ISO 19115 XML)
metadata.description: The DGED product's XML metadata, copied unchanged from the source tile folder.

geoparquet-items.title: STAC items as GeoParquet
geoparquet-items.description: Every item of this collection as one stac-geoparquet file, one row per tile, for querying the whole collection (for example with DuckDB) without fetching the item JSON files. Rebuilt with portolan stac-geoparquet whenever the items change.

thumbnail.title: Thumbnail
thumbnail.description: A window of the overview COG, rendered by tools/thumbs.sh.

overview.title: Global hillshaded elevation overview (COG)
overview.description: The whole collection in one 8-bit RGB + alpha COG in Web Mercator at about 1.2 km, for maps that should not open 26,475 items. Elevation tinted with a hypsometric ramp and multiplied by a hillshade. Alpha is 0 where no tile has data. Not elevation data: read the item COGs for heights. Web Mercator stops near 85 degrees, so most of Antarctica is not in it. produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved.
overview.processing:lineage: tools/overview.py: DEM COGs warped to EPSG:3857 (average), Horn hillshade (azimuth 315, altitude 45), hypsometric tint, 8-bit RGBA.
